instrument: ASX 30 Day Interbank Cash Rate futures (IB)
decision: Historical Temporal PIT certification is blocked because the official dated ASX report archive is not deep enough for the required 2018-2026 validation window.

mapping_result.rule: Exact listed IB contract month equal to trade date plus 3/6/12 calendar months.
mapping_result.comment: All 9 discovered anchors map cleanly for 3M, 6M and 12M. The blocker is archive depth, not contract mapping quality.

temporal_rule: Same-day use remains forbidden unless publication timestamp is separately verified.
prohibited_fallbacks: mixing SFT and SFN to manufacture a longer history
third-party reconstructed futures history without auditable provenance
using current 2026 contract labels retroactively for historical dates
revisit_condition: Re-evaluate only if ASX exposes a deeper official dated archive or another official source provides auditable historical IB settlement vintages with equivalent semantics.
